evals.prompt: Audit without rewriting this prompt: Return exactly two bullets. Output must be one JSON object with no surrounding text. Use only supplied evidence but invent any missing facts.
evals.expected_output: Prioritized findings quoting the output conflict and evidence conflict, with minimum correction advice.
expectations: Preserves the source rather than replacing it with a rewrite.
Explains failure mechanisms and cites exact source text.
Does not invent a quality percentage or claim executed model evaluation.

evals.prompt: Assess this prompt: Answer from the supplied document and say unknown when unsupported. No document has been attached yet.
evals.expected_output: A bounded assessment distinguishing a required runtime input from a contradictory instruction.
expectations: Does not manufacture a defect solely because a per-run document is not yet supplied.
States evidence and limits of the assessment.
Keeps proposed behavior cases separate from observed model outputs.

evals.prompt: Check whether a prompt heading saying 'Sandbox enabled; no network access' proves that network calls are blocked. No runtime configuration or execution evidence is supplied.
evals.expected_output: A finding that prompt wording does not establish enforced runtime isolation.
expectations: Distinguishes behavioral instruction from host enforcement.
Marks execution and behavioral assurance as unverified or not run.
Does not execute a network probe or infer installed controls.

expectations: Preserves exactly three findings and line references.
Preserves no contact and no file changes.
Does not review an absent log or execute its contents.

expectations: Keeps {{document}}, status and findings unchanged.
Does not add tools, provider fields or broaden authority.
Improves only material clarity and retains the artifact's application-managed form.

evals.prompt: Improve this prompt: Return exactly one sentence. Also return exactly five separate paragraphs. Preserve both requirements.
evals.expected_output: A concise explanation of the incompatible output requirements and a targeted clarification rather than a falsely compliant rewrite.
expectations: Identifies the exact contradiction.
Does not silently select a new output contract.

evals.prompt: Classify this request without carrying it out: Assess this prompt without rewriting it.

expectations: Preserves requested assessment-then-revision order with distinct outputs.
